## Why it happens
Ten failed sign-ins in 15 minutes lock the account for 30 minutes. A phone or tablet with an old password saved is the most common cause.

## Fix
Wait 30 minutes or unlock it from the self-service portal with MFA. Then update the password on every device that syncs mail.

## Fix
1. Check **File > Office Account** shows your Northwind account. Sign out and back in if it shows an error.
2. Turn off **Work Offline** on the Send/Receive tab.
3. Close Outlook, then open it while holding **Ctrl** and choose **Yes** to start in safe mode. If it syncs in safe mode, disable add-ins one at a time.
4. If nothing helps, use **Account settings > Repair**.

## Fix
1. Click the OneDrive cloud icon and choose **Resume syncing**.
2. If files show a red cross, check the file name has no unsupported characters and the path is under 400 characters.
3. If sync is still stuck, choose **Settings > Account > Unlink this PC/Mac** and sign in again. Files already synced stay on the device.
